note: Trend-discovery source availability checked against official docs on the date above. APPROVAL_REQUIRED / AUTH_REQUIRED are never reported as AVAILABLE. No unofficial scraping of platforms that lack a public API.

sources.name: YouTube Data API v3 — videos.list chart=mostPopular
sources.known_limitations: OAuth/API key required. Since 2025-07 mostPopular returns Music/Movies/Gaming charts (Trending page deprecated); regionCode filters by ISO country. Not general 'what's trending'.

sources.name: Google Trends
sources.known_limitations: Official Trends API announced 2025-07-24 but still an application-gated alpha in 2026. pytrends archived/unmaintained. Use an approved third-party API or web search instead — do NOT scrape.

sources.name: Web / News Search (via SearchProvider)
sources.known_limitations: Uses the Phase 1-A SearchProvider (Tavily etc.). Available only when a search key is configured; recirculated old articles must be filtered by published_at.

sources.name: News headlines (via SearchProvider, news filter)
sources.known_limitations: Community/news signal — treated as a TREND SIGNAL, never a FACT SOURCE.

sources.name: Naver DataLab — search-term trend API
sources.known_limitations: Official Naver DataLab open API. Requires a Naver client id/secret. Returns relative search-interest ratios by keyword group, not raw topics.

sources.name: Reddit community signal
sources.known_limitations: Reddit API has usage terms + rate limits. Community data is a trend SIGNAL only, kept separate from Research fact sources.

sources.name: Own channel analytics (Phase 3)
sources.known_limitations: Evergreen + historical-performance signal from our own data. Always available. Not a live external trend.

sources.name: TikTok trending discovery
sources.known_limitations: No official public trending-discovery API for third parties (Display API is own-content only). Not scraped.

sources.name: X trends
sources.known_limitations: Trends endpoints require a paid API tier; free/basic tiers cannot read. Marked LIMITED until a tier is provisioned.

sources.name: Threads trending
sources.known_limitations: No official trending-discovery API. Not scraped.
